newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland needs new power as Swedes shut nuclear - IVO.
newsitem.headline: Finland needs new power as Swedes shut nuclear - IVO.

text.p: Sweden's decision to close two nuclear power plants will increase Finland's need for more power capacity and a fifth nuclear power plant will again become topical, Imatran Voima (IVO) CEO Kalevi Numminen said on Friday.

He said IVO, a state-owned power producer, now plans to bring forward its decision to build new capacity, and it is prepared to start construction of a large coal or gas power plant in Naantali or Inkoo in southern Finland.
"The lack of capacity that will come in the Nordic countries will also make the project for a fifth nuclear power plant topical," Numminen said in a statement. @
He said IVO would be prepared to participate in a nuclear power project if the government and parliament guaranteed that this would be completed.
Finland imports about eight percent of its electricity consumption, he said. About one-third of its electricity is nuclear-generated.
